title: Renton Rowing Center
specs: Programs for all ages and experience levels, including youth and adults
Kayak and paddleboard rentals on Lake Washington with views of Boeing Field and wildlife
Basic swimming ability and comfort around water recommended for rentals
Grades 6 and up for youth rowing programs
Prior rowing experience required for Self-Rescue & Safety Clinic
Prior Learn to Row or equivalent experience required for adult membership
Private lessons available for up to 4 people per session, members only
includes: Instruction on rowing stroke, equipment handling, and teamwork in Learn to Row class
Access to coached programs with class pass or punch card
gap: Age minimum not explicitly stated for adult Learn to Row class
blurb: Renton Rowing Center offers rowing programs for youth grades 6-12 and adults, including learn to row classes and coached programs. They also provide kayak and stand up paddleboard rentals during summer. The center emphasizes safety, inclusivity, and community engagement in rowing.
extraNote: Rentals have a one hour minimum; last rentals go out at 7:00pm and must be returned by 8:00pm · Flexible adult memberships can be cancelled only by an administrator via email · Rentals cancelled if weather conditions are poor · Safety policies must be adhered to; failure can result in suspension or expulsion · Facility located at the end of the Cedar River Trail Park · Memorial Day through Labor Day for rentals; Fall and Summer seasons for rowing programs
